Friedrichshain ( German pronunciation: [ˈfʁiːdʁɪçsˌhaɪn] ⓘ ) is a quarter ( Ortsteil ) of the borough of Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg in Berlin , Germany. From its creation in 1920 until 2001, it was a freestanding city borough . Formerly part of East Berlin , it is adjacent to Mitte , Prenzlauer Berg , Kreuzberg and Lichtenberg .
